typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		assignment_group as string,
		opened_by as string,
		number as string,
		risk as string,
		state as string,
		start_date as date,
		end_date as date,
		short_description as string,
		sys_class_name as string,
		type as string,
		{cmdb_ci location} as string,
		cmdb_ci as string,
		requested_by as string,
		unauthorized as string,
		close_code as string,
		closed_at as date,
		made_sla as string,
		outside_maintenance_schedule as string,
		production_system as string,
		escalation as string,
		close_notes as string,
		{cmdb_ci u_wf_guid} as string,
		{cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name} as string,
		{cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		BuildingCampusName as string,
		ConfigurationItem as string,
		MadeSLA as string,
		Escalation as string,
		ProductionSystem as string,
		AssignmentGroup as string,
		Risk as string,
		OpenedBy as string,
		CloseCode as string,
		ShortDescription as string,
		PlannedStartDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Number as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		TaskType as string,
		Unauthorized as string,
		WorkplaceLocationNumber as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OutsideMaintenanceSchedule as string,
		Type as string,
		State as string,
		Closed as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CloseNotes as string,
		PlannedEndDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		u_wf_guid as string,
		RequestedBy as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BuildingCampusName = {cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name},
		ConfigurationItem = cmdb_ci,
		MadeSLA = made_sla,
		Escalation = escalation,
		ProductionSystem = production_system,
		AssignmentGroup = assignment_group,
		Risk = risk,
		OpenedBy = opened_by,
		CloseCode = close_code,
		ShortDescription = short_description,
		PlannedStartDate = start_date,
		Number = number,
		ETLUser,
		TaskType = sys_class_name,
		Unauthorized = unauthorized,
		WorkplaceLocationNumber = {cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number},
		UploadDate,
		OutsideMaintenanceSchedule = outside_maintenance_schedule,
		Type = type,
		State = state,
		Closed = closed_at,
		CloseNotes = close_notes,
		PlannedEndDate = end_date,
		u_wf_guid = {cmdb_ci u_wf_guid},
		RequestedBy = requested_by,
		Location = {cmdb_ci location}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
